title: DADA’S SECRET REVEALED: THE SILVER BOLT! 🛵
endcard: THE LEGEND OF SILVER BOLT LIVES ON

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: STOP THE BIKE right now [beat] because I cannot believe the infamous Silver Bolt of the city is actually my own grandfather!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Nix, keep your voice down [beat] before the whole neighborhood realizes that the most reliable courier in the district has a bedtime at nine!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You have been sneaking out every single night [beat] hitting a hundred percent delivery rate while we all thought you were just snoring in the den!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Look at this high-tech aerodynamic helmet [beat] and this customized engine, Dada you aren't just delivering food, you are basically a local legend!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I didn't do it for the street credit [beat] I did it because your Grandma’s old tea shop was going bankrupt and she is far too proud to ask for help!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: You old fool [beat] I knew you weren't just going for late-night walks when I found those extra-large pizza coupons hidden under our mattress!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Nani, I have saved every single cent from the tips [beat] and today the Silver Bolt officially retires because the shop’s mortgage is finally paid in full!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I tried to buy that shop for my new franchise last week [beat] but some mysterious high-speed investor outbid me by a single dollar and a warm cinnamon roll!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: That cinnamon roll was my signature move [beat] because every customer deserves a little bit of sugar with their midnight craving delivery!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I told everyone at the salon you were having a mid-life crisis [beat] but instead you were basically becoming the neighborhood superhero on two wheels!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, if the debt is paid and the shop is saved [beat] then why is your phone still buzzing with a premium order for the Mayor’s residence?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Old habits die hard [beat] and a true legend like the Silver Bolt never leaves a hungry customer waiting for their spicy ramen!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dada rode off into the sunrise [beat] proving that you are never too old to be the fastest delivery man in history and save the family business!
